summary: PR 1301 is test-only hardening. It has no production/native diff, and its complete six-test regression passes on both the recorded base and exact candidate. The actual ModelSlim checkpoint and Ascend deployment are unavailable, so the original accuracy failure remains unverified and unresolved.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate regression against recorded base source; 6 passed, proving the suite is not a candidate-specific failing-before regression.
Exact candidate regression at exact candidate commit; 6 passed.
Independent synthetic all-rank TP32-checkpoint-to-TP4 shard selection and malformed-shape rejection on AMD Instinct MI355X.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent adversarial tensor cases ran on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X. This is not Ascend or model-semantic validation.

remaining_counterexamples: The candidate's complete regression passes on the recorded base, so it does not demonstrate a candidate fix.
The candidate has no production or native-code change relative to the recorded base.
No test loads the reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim checkpoint or verifies its actual tensor names, shapes, ordering, and scale metadata.
No test measures generated-token equivalence or semantic accuracy for MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8.
No test executes the Ascend/CANN load and serving path or the reported two-node TP32/DP4 topology.
remaining_limitations: The reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim checkpoint is absent.
Ascend/CANN, torch_npu, and NPU devices are unavailable.
Only one AMD Instinct MI355X is assigned; the two-node TP32/DP4 topology cannot be reproduced.
Generated-token equivalence and semantic accuracy were not measured.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source.
